facts.claim: Grande Albergo delle Rose (Italian for 'Grand Hotel of Roses') says it opened on 24 May 1927 and calls itself a historic landmark of Rhodes. Its home page says it is next to Rhodes' modern shopping area, within reach of the Medieval Town, and has an adjoining beach on the Aegean.

Grande Albergo delle Rose's Weddings page says it hosts weddings and offers indoor and outdoor options: a romantic poolside location near the seafront, a dramatic Amphitheatre setting, and the restaurant setting of Rodon Place. It states 'a seating capacity of 450 guests' for receptions.

Grande Albergo delle Rose's Weddings page says it has dedicated wedding planning staff, an in-house catering team, and banquet and sound equipment. Enquiries go to its wedding planning department; a wedding brochure is offered for download.

Grande Albergo delle Rose's site lists suite categories only (Classic, Junior, Grand, Queen, Dome and Presidential suites); the total room count and any exclusive-use option are not published on the pages read.
Grande Albergo delle Rose is at Georgiou Papanikolaou 4, Rhodes town, the same address as Casino Rodos, whose site links to the hotel. It is in Rhodes city, not inside the medieval walls.

Kókkini Porta Rossa describes itself as a quiet boutique hotel in Rhodes Old Town (its history page is titled 'The Hotel: 1340 to Today'). Its home page and menu read live show no weddings or events page, so it does not meet the inclusion rule.

Spirit of the Knights describes itself as a boutique hotel inside the walls of the Old Town with a garden and outdoor jacuzzi. Its home page read live lists suites, massage, tours and transfers but no weddings or events, so it does not meet the inclusion rule.

Allegory Boutique Hotel describes itself as 'luxury in the heart of Rhodes' medieval city' and a member of Yades Greek Historic Hotels. Its home page and menu read live show no weddings or events page, so it does not meet the inclusion rule.

Marco Polo Mansion's site (Hotel and Restaurant, Rhodes Old Town) has menu items for rooms, restaurant, gallery, press, contact and booking; no weddings or events page, so it does not meet the inclusion rule.

insider_details.detail: Grande Albergo delle Rose sits in Rhodes city rather than inside the medieval walls, so it suits couples who want a large seated reception (the hotel states 450) with the Old Town close by for portraits; within the walls, the boutique hotels read for this batch do not publish wedding offers.
With three named settings (poolside by the sea, the Amphitheatre and Rodon Place), ask Grande Albergo delle Rose which one is the weather backup for the others before you sign.
Old Town boutique hotels are small, suite-only properties; treat them as places to stay for the couple and family rather than as venues unless the hotel confirms in writing that it hosts events.
